botRequest.name: Retail Chatbot
botRequest.description:
Automate common product inquiries and provide more information on your business to streamline customer journey.

Use cases:

  • Streamline product ordering
  • Show product suggestions
  • Streamline product returns
  • Answer FAQs
  • Show order information and order history

Our payment offer are secure so you can enjoy shopping without worrying. 🔐

As for installment payments, unfortunately we do not offer them at the moment.

We have various payment options: 

📦 you can pay upon delivery 
💳 with credit card or 
💰 with the PayPal

Don't worry if you're not satisfied with your purchase or if you changed your mind, you have one month to return the product. 📅

Please allow up until 10 working days to see refund on your bank statement.
